title: Notices of the Board/Council meetings to SEBI nominated directors on the Exchange.
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Notices of the Board/Council meetings to SEBI nominated directors on the Exchange. Jan 15, 1996| Circulars DIVISION CHIEF SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT - I SMD(N)/JS/170/96 January 15, 1996 To, The Presidents / Executive Directors of all Stock Exchanges Dear Sir, Notices of the Board/Council meetings to SEBI nominated directors on the Exchange. We have received a communication from the DCA, New Delhi stating that their nominee directors on your Stock Exchange do not get adequate notice of the Board / Council meetings. The Stock Exchange is requested to ensure that hence- forth the notices of such meeting reach the concerned SEBI nominee Directors on the Exchanges well in time. Yours faithfully, sd/- R.V. NABAR
